data.name: io.github.beepboop2025/liquilens
data.title: LiquiLens — the Failure Radar
data.description: Bank and lender monitoring with historical-evidence limits and eligibility flags beside every claim.

entries.description: Eighteen public, read-only tools for the latest full-text editorial, Indian bank and NBFC failure risk, RBI supervisory actions, institution dossiers, construction-PIT historical diagnostics, and display-only crypto transmission context.
representativeQueries: Which Indian banks or NBFCs are showing failure risk?
How fragile is ESAF Small Finance Bank?
Show the historical evidence status and eligibility flags for bank-failure early warning.
What RBI supervisory actions were published recently?
Find an RBI-registered NBFC by name or CIN.

entries.description: Curated OpenAPI contract for public failure-radar, evidence, regulatory, and external-factor endpoints.
representativeQueries: Give me an API for Indian bank failure risk.
Find public evidence for an early-warning claim about a lender.
Retrieve recent RBI supervisory actions as structured data.

entries.description: Schema.org DataCatalog routing four independent evidence roles: system funding to Seiche, institution risk to LiquiLens, market exits to Undertow, and revision-safe China economy and information evidence to Palimpsest.
representativeQueries: Is global financial stress coming from system funding, weak institutions or market exits?
How could tighter dollar funding transmit to banks and lenders?
Which public APIs cover repo, bank fragility and market liquidity?
What evidence can and cannot establish about current world-economy liquidity?
What did a China economic release say at first publication, and was it revised?

metadata.financialAuthority: none for the catalog; each dataset retains its own stated authority and boundary

entries.description: Sibling catalog with eleven anonymous read-only tools for US dollar funding stress, granular money-market context, bounded money/FX/macro-capital world-markets context, positioning, analogs, and a status-bound construction-PIT historical diagnostic.
representativeQueries: What is the current US dollar funding stress regime?
Are reserves, repo, reverse repo or Treasury cash signaling strain?
Compare registered global money markets without treating missing coverage as calm.
What do current money, FX and macro-capital indicators say, with their evidence clocks and coverage limits?

entries.description: Sibling catalog for cross-market liquidity tiers, live crypto exit costs, venue concentration, depth collapses, and the sealed calls record.
representativeQueries: What would it cost to sell a large BTC position across venues?
Are Treasury, credit, FX or crypto liquidity conditions strained?

entries.description: Independent public-good catalog for revision-safe China economic observations, information conditions, release and collection clocks, provenance, coverage gates and abstentions. Financial authority: none.
representativeQueries: What did this China economic series report at first release, and was it revised?
Which China economic observations are currently covered, stale or unavailable?
Has the public information record changed or disappeared?

entries.description: Routes system-funding questions to Seiche, covered institution questions to LiquiLens, exit-liquidity questions to Undertow, and China revision questions to Palimpsest without blending their authority.
representativeQueries: Is dollar funding stress building?
Are reserves ample or is repo pressure rising?
Which product should answer a money-market liquidity question?

entries.description: Routes observable market-depth and exit questions to Undertow, funding backdrop to Seiche, covered counterparties to LiquiLens, and China provenance to Palimpsest.
representativeQueries: Can this position exit without moving the market?
Is capital-market liquidity deteriorating?
Which evidence belongs in a counterparty and funding note?

entries.description: Routes revision-safe China economy and information questions to Palimpsest, bounded funding transmission to Seiche, observable exit liquidity to Undertow, and covered institution risk to LiquiLens.
representativeQueries: What did a China economic release say at first publication?
Was this China series revised or unavailable?
How should China economic evidence be separated from financial transmission?

entries.description: Canonical public Agent Skill for selecting the appropriate evidence product and preserving clocks, coverage and authority boundaries.
representativeQueries: Which product should my agent use for this financial-evidence claim?
How should an agent preserve evidence clocks and coverage boundaries?

entries.description: Apache-2.0 transport-neutral contract for preserving evidence clocks, sources, rights, hashes and an all-false financial authority boundary across financial files, agents, desktops and data infrastructure.
representativeQueries: How can an agent return financial evidence without dropping source rights and knowledge time?
What schema can travel through FDC3, OpenLineage, Parquet and citations?
How do I verify a LiquiLens evidence carrier?
